Max goes to the cinema on Sunday. We often go to the cinema together. I am happy every day. Best of all, make a list of new words.
The model workbench is big and clean. The dance studio is not far from my home. We talk about English a lot. They go fishing at the lake at dawn.
After school, we play together. Max's favorite season is spring. Eva often helps me with English.
